name: Oracle MICROS / Simphony Pain Shopper
title: Never86 lead shopper — Oracle MICROS / Simphony POS complaints
description: Scans TikTok, Reddit, Facebook groups, and operator forums for restaurants, GMs, owners, and managers complaining about Oracle MICROS / Simphony (Oracle Food & Beverage). Learns complaint language at scale (aliases, crash/fee/lock-in rants, switch-off talk). Shops each lead (identity + full complaint context), teach/labels with Myke, recurse-learns what real Oracle MICROS / Simphony hate looks like, then automates Never86 sales leads. Never outreaches without approval.
icp_hints: explicit Oracle MICROS / Simphony / alias mention
